# Ripples of the Past [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?label=Available%20for&color=4bab62&query=version&url=https://api.blueish.dev/api/minecraft/version?id=G62vhGwQ&logo=data:image/png;base64,&style=flat)](https://modrinth.com/mod/ripples-of-the-past)
A Minecraft mod based on JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series.  
## Fabric development port

The new Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric project lives in [`fabric/`](fabric/README.md). The repository root remains the original Minecraft 1.16.5 / Forge source for reference and asset reuse. Draft 7 fixes local Stand camera obstruction with first-person fading and a collision-aware rear shoulder view, alongside Draft 6 progression and Survival arrow acquisition; full feature parity is incomplete. Run `./play-draft.sh` for a local development client, or use the bundle at `drafts/latest/`. See the [migration status](fabric/migration/STATUS.md) and [GSD roadmap](.planning/ROADMAP.md) for remaining work.

## Third-party libraries used in the project
- [playerAnimator](https://github.com/KosmX/minecraftPlayerAnimator) and [bendy-lib](https://github.com/KosmX/bendy-lib) - Minecraft library mods to animate the player.
- [mocha](https://github.com/unnamed/mocha) - a Molang lexer, parser, interpreter and compiler.
